verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents voicemail transcription ('Voicemail with transcriptions', 'Read voicemail-to-text'), and users can read voicemails in the app or dashboard 'as texts', so they don't need to dial in. However, the evidence only shows reading inside Community Phone's own app and dashboard. Nothing shows transcripts being pushed out to email or a chat tool. Missing for 10: documented delivery of voicemail transcripts to email, documented delivery to chat/SMS channels outside the app, independent or hands-on corroboration of transcription quality.
